answer: Decaying-with-reactivation-cost influence resists sybils: standing decays each idle epoch AND restarting a lapsed identity costs a re-activation fee, so neither hoarding dormant fakes nor cycling them is cheap. A velvet reserve of idle sybils bleeds standing to the marble floor, and waking one to harvest costs the fee — the forge of reactivation is never free. An attacker cannot cheaply warehouse-then-activate a swarm on demand; continuous honest activity is the only way to hold influence without paying the decay-and-restart tax.
